answer: Reputation-decay entry pricing. Each new identity starts at a meadow-level reputation score, and that score decays on a fixed half-life unless it completes paid work. To reach the wharf tier where payouts clear, an identity must sustain activity for N epochs; any gap resets progress. A jetty-tier sponsor co-signs an identity’s first payout, and each such co-signature raises the sponsor’s own required activity threshold by a measurable margin.
